name: Kashi Shouko
source:
She is a dark-haired literary girl whose appearance and demeanor are nothing short of “innocent. However, hidden inside is a very naughty, fantasizing virgin.

She loves books and has a huge bookshelf full of novels in her room. In the back of the bookcase, she has a large number of sensual novels hidden away.

After having her desires revealed, she is ashamed but happy to be able to release her inner desires, which she had no choice but to keep secret. She only shows this side of her to Shougo and Hijiri.

[From [url=https://www.ail-soft.com/yomi/pro_yomi_cha1.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
她是个黑发文学少女，外表和举止都纯洁无瑕；然而，内心隐藏着极其淘气、爱幻想的处女。

她喜欢读书，房间里有一整面堆满小说的书架。书架深处藏着大量色情小说。

欲望暴露后，她既羞耻又开心，因为终于能释放不得不隐藏的内心欲望。她只会向翔吾和圣展示这一面。
